# ASTM International

> ASTM International develops and publishes voluntary consensus standards, technical publications, and testing methods for materials, products, systems, and services across industries worldwide.

The organization produces thousands of standards covering construction materials, environmental testing, medical devices, geotechnical engineering, thermal insulation, ceramics, carbon materials, and additive manufacturing. ASTM standards like D5832, D5159, and D7385 are widely referenced in industry and regulatory frameworks.

## Key Topics

- ASTM Standards
- Materials Testing
- Construction Standards
- Medical Device Standards
- Environmental Standards
- Geotechnical Engineering
- Additive Manufacturing
- Carbon Standards and Activated Carbon
- Glass and Ceramic Standards
- Thermal Insulation
- Testing Methods and Procedures
- Technical Publications (STPs)
- UOP Petroleum Standards
- Standards Development

## Materials and Construction Standards

- [Carbon Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/carbon-standards.html): ASTM carbon standards for activated carbon testing and evaluation methods
- [Glass Standards and Ceramic Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/glass-standards-and-ceramic-standards.html): ASTM glass and ceramic materials testing standards and specifications
- [Thermal Insulation Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/thermal-insulation-standards.html): ASTM thermal insulation testing and material specification standards
- [Geotechnical Engineering Standards](https://store.astm.org/geotechnical-engineering-standards): ASTM geotechnical engineering, soil testing, and foundation standards

## Industry-Specific Standards

- [Medical Device Standards and Implant Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/medical-device-standards-and-implant-standards.html): ASTM medical device, implant, and biomedical materials standards
- [Environmental Standards](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/standards/environmental-standards.html): ASTM environmental safety, waste management, and water testing standards
- [UOP Standards](https://store.astm.org/uop_standards): Honeywell UOP petroleum testing and analytical method standards

## Technical Publications and Research

- [Technical Reports](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/technical-reports.html): ASTM/ISO technical reports on additive manufacturing and research data
- [Manuals, Monographs, & Data Series](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/mnl.html): ASTM technical manuals, monographs, and data series publications
- [All Published Symposia Papers & STPs](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/symposia-papers/all-symposia-papers.html): ASTM symposia papers catalog covering materials testing and engineering

## Standards Development Resources

- [Form and Style for ASTM Standards](https://store.astm.org/form-style-for-astm-stds.html): ASTM standards writing style guide for technical committees
- [ASTM Training and E-Learning Policies and FAQs](https://store.astm.org/restricted_tpt-faq): ASTM training registration, payment, and cancellation policy FAQs

## Optional

- [Open Access Policy](https://store.astm.org/products-services/standards-and-publications/journals/open-access.html): ASTM International open access publishing policy and author rights
